2608.16765.title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
2608.16765.paper_summary: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. Building on this formulation, we construct TRACE-Bench, comprising approximately 1,600 evaluation cases across slot counts 1--8, built from 631 formula templates and around 4,000 reference images spanning diverse artistic styles and real-world subjects. The formula structure directly drives an operator-aligned evaluation protocol for per-capability scoring and a diagnostic tree analysis for recursive failure localization. Evaluating 9 leading models reveals insights invisible to holistic scoring: the primary bottleneck lies in disentanglement ($g$) and attribute binding ($\oplus$) rather than scene-level composition ($C$), with even the best model scoring only 0.74 on attribute fidelity. Project page: https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench
2608.16765.paper_summary_zh: 儘管最近在統一多模態模型的多參考圖像生成方面取得了進展，但現有基準仍然圍繞預定的任務類型（例如，“主題組合”）組織，這些任務類型不適合這種組合設置，並導致覆蓋面分散、複雜性失控以及診斷價值低下。認識到多樣的多參考任務共享一組共同的基本操作，我們採取了一種以能力為導向的視角，並形式化了四個操作符：Anchor ($f$)、Disentangle ($g$)、Apply ($\oplus$) 和 Compose ($C$)。任何多參考提示都可以表示為這些操作符的組合公式，其結構複雜性由操作符槽的數量來量化。在此基礎上，我們構建了TRACE-Bench，包含約1,600個評估案例，涵蓋槽數1到8，這些案例是從631個公式模板和約4,000張涵蓋多樣藝術風格和現實主題的參考圖像中構建的。公式結構直接驅動了對應能力的評估協議，以便進行每個能力的打分和遞歸失敗定位的診斷樹分析。對9個領先模型的評估揭示了整體打分無法看見的見解：主要瓶頸在於解耦 ($g$) 和屬性綁定 ($\oplus$)，而不是場景級組合 ($C$)，即使是最好的模型在屬性保真度上也僅得分0.74。項目頁面：https://amuseum-whr.github.io/TraceBench
